messages:
Elaine (growth): Kicking off a 'Snippet Sprint' to produce 8–12 micro-tutorials + an hour-long demo webinar next Thu. Goal: quick wins for OSS refapp adoption and a single benchmark narrative. Who can own content, webinar ops, and lead-routing? :rocket:
Sam (devrel): I'm in for tutorials. Can take 4 snippets: embedding quickstart, streaming integration, batching tips, and a mini-k8s deploy guide. Need code examples and a short checklist per snippet.
Paul (pm): I'll own the webinar flow and benchmark narrative. Proposal: 20m demo, 15m benchmarking talk (cost/latency tradeoffs), 15m Q&A. Wants a scripted runbook.
Nina (design): I can do 8 hero screenshots and 4 GIFs for snippets. Can we agree on a consistent header template? I'll mock by EOD tomorrow.
Sam (devrel): For code layout let's use the same 3-file pattern: 1) quickstart.py, 2) sample_input.json, 3) README.md. We'll include a one-liner benchmark snippet.
Paul (pm): For messaging A/B test: A) 'Ship fast with Redwood refapp' B) 'Cut inference cost by X% with snippet optimizations' — want to try both on community channels.
Elaine (growth): I'll own outbound posts and blog post postmortem. Need copy variants + metadata for inbound lead routing (which tags to add). @ryan can you set up tracking?
ryan (web): Yep — will create two UTM flows and a gated demo sign-up form. For lead routing, suggest: webinar registrants -> SDR queue; code downloads -> DevRel nurture; enterprise contact forms -> AE route. I'll map on Monday.
ops-bot: Reminder — set calendar event for webinar when slot confirmed. Use template: "Snippet Sprint: Live Demo & Benchmarks".
Sam (devrel): Benchmark narrative idea: show two configs (default vs optimized): tokens/sec, p95 latency, and $$ per 1M tokens. We'll include a short script to reproduce locally using small model.
Nina (design): For the social cards, do we want performance callouts (e.g., '2x throughput') or more product-focused lines? I vote performance callouts for dev channels, product lines for biz channels.
Paul (pm): Agreed. We'll split assets. Elaine please prepare PR blurbs for both angles.
Elaine (growth): Will do. Quick ops question: do we want a staging refapp site for demo? Prefer not to expose prod keys. Sam/ryan — can we spin a demo env with read-only demo keys?
Sam (devrel): Yes, I'll create a disposable demo environment (k8s namespace + limited GPU) and publish creds in 1Password with E2 expiry.
ryan (web): I'll wire a redirect from the marketing page to the demo site for the webinar landing. Tagging: utm_campaign=snippet_sprint, utm_variant=A/B.
Paul (pm): Next steps: assign snippet owners (Sam: 4, Elaine: 2 walkthroughs for onboarding, Nina: visuals, Ryan: landing & forms, Paul: webinar script). Sam, can you drop a short repo skeleton by tomorrow?
Sam (devrel): On it — will push skeleton and reference templates to https://github.com/redwood-inference/snippet-sprint by 10:00 PT tomorrow.
Elaine (growth): Timeline check: content drafts due Tue EOD, design assets Wed noon, landing + forms Wed EOD, dry run Thu morning, go-live webinar Thu 11am PT. Comments?
Nina (design): timeline works for me.
Paul (pm): Works for me. I'll schedule dry run and invite presenters.
Elaine (growth): Great — tagging this thread as the single source of truth. Add any blockers here. :white_check_mark:
Sam (devrel): One blocker: need a short policy for including model weights in the repo (license check). I'll draft and ping legal if needed.
Elaine (growth): Thanks, will loop in legal if Sam confirms. Also will draft short copy variants for social; will post them here for quick approvals.
Paul (pm): Nice — thanks everyone. I'll update the project tracker after the skeleton lands.
Elaine (growth): :thumbsup:
